items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that the one with Jack Webb? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right.

ctx.x: Is that the one with Jack Webb? © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

That’s right. It’s getting to be kind of a cult thing now. Because it wasn’t really panned but there wasn’t much good said about it when it first came out, but I notice now they play it on A&E, and on Movie Classics, and they say three stars. So I think people think more of it now than they did in those days. I always thought oh gee — have you seen it?
